title: AlphaFold2-Multimer screen of the 53BP1 pathway predicts a RIF1-SHLD3 interface that is confirmed in cells
summary: Sifri et al. used AlphaFold2-Multimer to predict all pairwise interactions in the 53BP1-RIF1-shieldin-CST pathway, recovered seven known interfaces and predicted a new one between the RIF1 HEAT-repeat domain and the SHLD3 eIF4E-like domain. Pulldown and cellular assays supported the model and showed the interaction is needed for shieldin recruitment, class switch recombination and PARP inhibitor sensitivity. First public version: bioRxiv 2023-01-12; journal version 2023-06-12. Abstract-level review only.
organization: Lunenfeld-Tanenbaum Research Institute, Mount Sinai Hospital

evidence.tested: The predicted interface was tested by in vitro pulldown and cellular assays, per the abstract.
evidence.unknown: Full Methods, mutant-design details and independent replication were not assessed; the 2023-01-12 date is the bioRxiv posting (10.1101/2023.01.12.523815), version differences not compared.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold2-Multimer predicted pairwise complexes and proposed the novel RIF1-SHLD3 interface that guided the experiments.

source_review.scope: abstract and bibliographic metadata (Europe PMC) only; Methods not assessed
